blocks.tamil_translation: most ordinary among you.” And he said, “Allah, His angels, all the creatures in the heavens and the earth, the ants in their holes, and even the fish (in the water, each in its own way) make Du'a for mercy (Rahmah) to shower upon the one who teaches people what is good.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ يَقُوْلَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: أَلَا إِنَّ الدُّنْيَا مَلْعُونَةٌ مَلْعُونٌ مَّا فِيهَا إِلَّا ذِكْرُ اللهِ وَمَا وَالاَهُ وَعَالِمٌ أَوْ مُتَعَلِّمٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب باب منه حديث ان الدنيا ملعونة رقم:٢٣٢٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates, I heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “Listen carefully! The world and everything in the world are kept far away from the Rahmah (mercy) of Allah, except the Dhikr of Allah and whatever helps one draw near to Him, an Alim, or a student who learns Ilm.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: اُغْدُ عَالِماً أَوْ مُتَعَلِّماً أَوْ مُسْتَمِعاً أَوْ مُحِبّاً وَلَا تَكُنِ الْخَامِسَةَ فَتَهْلِكَ وَالْخِامِسَةُ أَنْ تُبْغِضَ الْعِلْمَ وَأَهْلَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الثلاثة والبزار ورجاله موثقون مجمع الزوائد:١٢٢/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Bakrah (RA) narrates, I heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “Be either an Alim, or one who learns Ilm, or one who listens attentively to Ilm, or else one who loves Ilm and the scholars of (knowledge); (apart from these four) do not become the fifth kind! Otherwise you will be destroyed. The fifth kind is to bear hatred towards knowledge and the people of knowledge.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُود ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: لَا حَسَدَ
